# game-dev — the reference page, verbatim

## GameArcade

```tsx
// REFERENCE PAGE — the gaming set (category: game). Never shipped to a project.
//
// A game is a STATE MACHINE with four screens, and the screens are what scaffolded games skip: a real
// menu, a HUD that stays put, a game-over that shows the run's numbers, and a persistent leaderboard.
// The game itself here is deliberately tiny (a reaction round: press when the panel arms) so the file
// stays about the SHAPE — phase union, derived HUD, top-5 persistence — not about physics. The game-dev
// skill owns the canvas/rAF patterns for real mechanics; these screens wrap ANY of them unchanged.

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Gamepad2, RotateCcw, Trophy, Zap } from 'lucide-react'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/blocks/EmptyState'
import { Hero } from '@/components/blocks/Hero'
import { NavBar } from '@/components/blocks/NavBar'
import { Section } from '@/components/blocks/Section'
import { StatCard } from '@/components/blocks/StatCard'
import { ArtImage } from '@/components/blocks/ArtImage'

// The phase union IS the game (game-dev skill): every screen is one phase, transitions are explicit.
type Phase = { kind: 'menu' } | { kind: 'playing' } | { kind: 'gameover'; score: number }

interface ScoreRow {
	name: string
	score: number
	date: string
}

const BOARD_KEY = 'arcade:leaderboard'
const ROUNDS = 5

export function GameArcade() {
	const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>({ kind: 'menu' })
	const [round, setRound] = useState(1)
	const [score, setScore] = useState(0)
	const [armed, setArmed] = useState(false) // the panel is "hot" — a press now scores
	const [flash, setFlash] = useState<string | null>(null)
	const [board, setBoard] = useState<ScoreRow[]>(() => {
		try {
			return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(BOARD_KEY) ?? '[]') as ScoreRow[]
		} catch {
			return []
		}
	})
	const armTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>(undefined)
	const armedAt = useRef(0)

	const best = useMemo(() => (board.length ? Math.max(...board.map((r) => r.score)) : 0), [board])

	const arm = () => {
		setArmed(false)
		armTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
			setArmed(true)
			armedAt.current = performance.now()
		}, 900 + Math.random() * 1600)
	}

	const start = () => {
		setScore(0)
		setRound(1)
		setPhase({ kind: 'playing' })
		arm()
	}

	const finish = (finalScore: number) => {
		clearTimeout(armTimer.current)
		setPhase({ kind: 'gameover', score: finalScore })
		// Top-5, best-first, persisted — the leaderboard survives reload (readJSON/writeJSON seam).
		const next = [...board, { name: 'You', score: finalScore, date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) }]
			.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
			.slice(0, 5)
		setBoard(next)
		localStorage.setItem(BOARD_KEY, JSON.stringify(next))
	}

	const press = () => {
		if (phase.kind !== 'playing') return
		if (!armed) {
			setFlash('Too early — that round scores 0.')
			setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 900)
			nextRound(score)
			return
		}
		const ms = Math.round(performance.now() - armedAt.current)
		const gained = Math.max(0, 500 - ms) // faster press, higher score
		setFlash(`${ms}ms — +${gained}`)
		setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 900)
		nextRound(score + gained)
	}

	const nextRound = (nextScore: number) => {
		setScore(nextScore)
		setArmed(false)
		if (round >= ROUNDS) finish(nextScore)
		else {
			setRound((r) => r + 1)
			arm()
		}
	}

	useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(armTimer.current), [])

	return (
		<div>
			<NavBar
				brand={
					<>
						<Gamepad2 className="size-4 text-primary" /> Pulse Arcade
					</>
				}
				actions={phase.kind === 'playing' ? <Badge variant="secondary">Round {round}/{ROUNDS}</Badge> : undefined}
			/>

			{phase.kind === 'menu' ? (
				// THE MENU is a Hero: name, one-line rules, ONE primary start. Games start on a title screen,
				// never mid-game — and the best score is already visible, because that is the hook.
				<Hero
					layout="centered"
					badge={best > 0 ? <Badge variant="secondary">Best: {best.toLocaleString()}</Badge> : undefined}
					headline="Pulse"
					subcopy={`Five rounds. Press the panel the instant it arms — the faster you are, the more you score. Pressing early scores nothing.`}
					actions={
						<>
							<Button size="lg" onClick={start}>
								<Zap className="size-4" /> Start run
							</Button>
						</>
					}
				/>
			) : phase.kind === 'playing' ? (
				<Section>
					{/* THE HUD: fixed slots that never appear/disappear mid-game — a layout-stable strip. */}
					<div className="mx-auto flex max-w-2xl flex-col gap-6">
						<div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
							<StatCard label="Score" value={score.toLocaleString()} />
							<StatCard label="Round" value={`${round}/${ROUNDS}`} />
							<StatCard label="Best" value={best.toLocaleString()} />
						</div>
						<button
							type="button"
							onClick={press}
							className={
								armed
									? 'flex h-64 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-primary text-2xl font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition-colors'
									: 'flex h-64 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed bg-muted/40 text-2xl font-semibold text-muted-foreground transition-colors'
							}
						>
							{armed ? 'NOW' : 'wait for it…'}
						</button>
						{/* Fixed-height feedback slot — text changes, layout never jumps (UI breathing-room rule). */}
						<p className="h-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{flash ?? ' '}</p>
					</div>
				</Section>
			) : (
				<Section eyebrow="Run complete" heading={`${phase.score.toLocaleString()} points`} description={phase.score >= best && phase.score > 0 ? 'New personal best.' : 'The board remembers only the top five.'}>
					<div className="mx-auto flex max-w-2xl flex-col gap-8">
						<div className="flex gap-3">
							<Button size="lg" onClick={start}>
								<RotateCcw className="size-4" /> Play again
							</Button>
							<Button size="lg" variant="outline" onClick={() => setPhase({ kind: 'menu' })}>
								Back to menu
							</Button>
						</div>
						{/* THE LEADERBOARD: rank · name · score · date. Top-5, persisted, EmptyState when fresh. */}
						<div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
							<h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
								<Trophy className="size-4" /> Leaderboard
							</h2>
							{board.length === 0 ? (
								<EmptyState title="No runs yet" description="Finish a run and it lands here." />
							) : (
								<div className="divide-y rounded-xl border bg-card">
									{board.map((r, i) => (
										<div key={`${r.score}-${i}`} className="flex items-center gap-4 px-4 py-3">
											<span className="w-6 font-serif text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{i + 1}</span>
											<span className="flex-1 font-medium">{r.name}</span>
											<span className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{r.score.toLocaleString()}</span>
											<span className="text-sm tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{r.date}</span>
										</div>
									))}
								</div>
							)}
						</div>
						<div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border [&_svg]:h-40 [&_svg]:w-full">
							<ArtImage seed="pulse-arcade" kind="banner" />
						</div>
					</div>
				</Section>
			)}
		</div>
	)
}
```
